name: legal-platform
description: Indian Legal Advisor Bot & Advocate Connect — monorepo

scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.kb:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.seed_corpus
scripts.kb:discover: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.discover_corpus
scripts.kb:discover:ingest: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.discover_corpus --ingest
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
